scientific_integrity: The algebraic proof uses the directional expansion, explicit parametrization and finite-field multiplicative orders. Computational checks are finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The geometric existence and number of 28 fourfold tangents are known. The reported refinement is the complete Frobenius-orbit spectrum and extension-field counts for the specific plane model over F3. Historical work on its arithmetic twists may contain equivalent calculations; independent external verification has not been carried out.
title: Arithmetic Frobenius orbits of the hyperosculating tangents to the Klein quartic in characteristic three
